pages.text: Gradient descent on a bowl f = ½λx²: from x, a step h against the slope λx lands at x(1 − hλ). So each step multiplies the distance from the bottom by |1 − hλ|. Below hλ = 1 it creeps in; at exactly 1 it lands; between 1 and 2 it overshoots and swings back; above 2 every swing is wider than the last.
$(thing)Set$(): Step size, Steps.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): A warped bowl: the curvature λ varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): The step is so big that every swing is wider than the last.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Fewer steps are faster.
